newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two Hong Kong men shot dead by police in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Two Hong Kong men shot dead by police in Manila.

text.p: Philippine police said on Sunday they shot dead two Hong Kong Chinese men whom they said belonged to a drug trafficking syndicate.
The shootings ocurred in Manila's Chinatown district on Saturday as police tried to arrest the pair. One police officer was wounded, Captain Lucio Margallo said.
Police seized about eight kilos (18 lb) of methamphetamine hydrochloride, also called "ice", Margallo told reporters. The drugs were worth about 10 million pesos ($385,000), he said.
Margallo identified the slain suspects as Henry Lau and Peter Chen, allegedly members of Hong Kong's 14K triad gang.
